content.question: Mandurah State Emergency Services
content.subtitle: A non-profit, volunteer-run emergency services unit in Australia, funded by government and community donations

content.text: A compromise connected to mandurahses.org.au was not detected by any other infostealer or exposure platform we checked.
content.accent: A compromise connected to mandurahses.org.au was not detected

content.question: Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms Bureau
content.subtitle: On Aug 26, Qilin group listed the ATF as a victim on their leak site

content.text:
ATF is responding to a cybersecurity incident affecting a standalone system... coordinating closely with the Department of Justice to investigate.

Senior Department officials have designated the event a “major incident” under applicable federal guidelines.
content.author: —ATF, Aug 26

content.text: The claims concern the release of material related to ATF investigative matters from ATF’s CALEA system, a system used in connection with the federal Communications Assistance for Law Enforcement Act (CALEA).
content.accent: concern the release of material related to ATF investigative matters
content.author: —ATF, AUG 31

content.question: Kyndryl Breach
content.subtitle: Company created from IBM's infrastructure service business. It designs, builds, and runs mission-critical enterprise technology with $15B revenue

content.text: TheHatman claimed ~170,000 records from Azure/Entra employee directory with job roles, managers, internal email structures, group mappings. Initial access from compromised credentials

One infection harvested 9 emails across 171 URLS, including: Netflix, Crunchyroll, Google, eBay, Barclay, Steam, Facebook, Nvidia, Ubisoft, Anime Addicts, ActiVision, TransferWise, Paypal, Amazon, Simplepay...
content.accent: One infection harvested 9 emails across 171 URLS,

content.text: One infection harvested 42 emails across 710 URLS... OpenAi, Hack-a-Flag, Hugging Face, Riot Games, Instagram, Ashley Madison, Coinbase, Zoho, Workday, Hack the Box, Tumblr, Disney+, Mining Pool Hub, Docker, Trello, TryHackMe, Amazon, Burger King
content.accent: One infection harvested 42 emails across 710 URLS
